calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract its 60-session rolling beta to the cross-asset median return times the median market return from its one-day return, then reverse the idiosyncratic shock. Amplify reversal during unusually large DXY moves using a trailing robust median/MAD score. DXY is observation-only and is never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.056158, 743 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.048872, 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.030424, 574 dates). Small 15-instrument cross-section; uncertainty is addressed through 1,833 historical date observations.
